figures.title: Core tests of the Week 6 candidate (T2-T4)
figures.interpretation: On a locked hold-out of 999 appointments the candidate scores AUC 0.479 (95% CI 0.424-0.534); across 10 repeated CV runs the AUC ranges 0.491-0.515, and the observed AUC sits inside the cloud of AUCs produced by shuffled labels (p = 0.51). The Week 6 result is reproducible, but it is a null result.

figures.title: Gains, calibration and operating policy (T6-T8)
figures.interpretation: Targeting by score captures positives at almost exactly the random-targeting rate (gain curve on the diagonal), predicted probabilities span only 0.04-0.28, and the Week 6 F1-maximising threshold flags 95% of appointments with lift 1.01x: an operating point that is indistinguishable from flagging everyone.

figures.title: Segment performance of the candidate (T10)
figures.interpretation: AUC is near 0.5 in every segment (0.36-0.59); only 5 of 50 intervals exclude 0.5, about what chance alone gives. But who gets flagged is uneven: the flag rate ranges 14%-36% across age bands, because the score follows noise in facility, BMI and age. Recall tracks the flag rate and precision stays at prevalence in every group, so the unequal flagging buys no accuracy.

figures.title: Harness validity and feature importance (T11-T12)
figures.interpretation: Both positive controls are recovered (green bars), so the test method can detect signal when it exists. The Week 6 admission proxy and every clinical or financial outcome stay at AUC 0.50 within their intervals (blue). The one detected outcome (red), returning patient, is a counting artifact: prior visits can only grow as the year passes, so month predicts it; it disappears when month is removed. No feature in the candidate has importance beyond noise.

figures.title: Before and after refinement (R1-R4)
figures.interpretation: Refinement removed the over-fitting (train-validation gap 0.24 to 0.05) and the unreliable features, but it cannot create signal: hold-out AUC is 0.467, still at chance level (CI 0.410-0.522) and the permutation p-value is 0.72. The model is now honest rather than better.
